title: LTE Symbol Demodulator
text: Demodulate complex LTE data symbols to data bits or LLR values, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Modulation} sets Modulation type; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation, {Decision type} sets the type of demapping and {Rounding Method} sets the rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Output demodulated data bits or LLR values scalar

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: Source for modulation type Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Rounding Method
params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero
